q19485.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with a soft verge.

explain.short: The car's wheel sinks at the edge: the verge is soft and gives way.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'cedevole' means soft, it gives way under weight.

sceneParams.caption: Soft verge ahead

q19486.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with an unusable verge.

explain.short: You cannot drive or stop safely on this verge.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'non praticabile' means you cannot use it.

sceneParams.caption: Verge you cannot use

q19487.en: The sign shown warns of a possible danger of falling into the ditch beside the road.

explain.short: If the wheels go onto the soft verge, the car can slide into the ditch.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'cunetta' here means the side ditch next to the road.

sceneParams.caption: Risk of sliding into the side ditch

q19488.en: The sign shown warns of a stretch of road with a dangerous verge.

explain.short: This is the name of the sign: 'banchina pericolosa'.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'banchina' (verge) is the strip beside the carriageway, not the road itself.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous verge

q19489.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: It is a triangle with a red border: the shape of danger signs.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'segnale di pericolo' (danger sign) = red-edged triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Red-edged triangle = danger sign

q19490.en: With the sign shown, it is advisable not to get too close to the right edge of the road.

explain.short: The right verge is soft: stay away from it so the wheels do not slip off.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'margine destro' means the right edge of the road.

sceneParams.caption: Keep away from the right edge

q19491.en: The sign shown must be paired with a speed limit sign.

explain.short: The sign works alone: a speed limit is not required.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'deve' (must) is the trap: nothing must be added.

sceneParams.caption: No speed limit required

q19492.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: A red-edged triangle is a danger sign; information signs are rectangles.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'segnale di indicazione' (information sign) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Danger sign, not information sign

q19493.en: The sign shown warns that you may not continue along that road.

explain.short: It only warns of a dangerous verge: you can go on, carefully.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'divieto' (ban) is the trap: danger signs never forbid.

sceneParams.caption: You can go on: it only warns

q19494.en: The sign shown warns of a damaged road.

explain.short: The danger is the verge at the side, not the road surface.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'strada dissestata' (damaged road) is the trap: that is 'strada deformata'.

sceneParams.caption: Danger at the verge, not the road surface

q19495.en: The sign shown warns of loose gravel on the road surface.

explain.short: The small stones in the drawing are the verge crumbling; loose gravel has its own sign.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'pietrisco' (loose gravel) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous verge, not loose gravel

q19496.en: The sign shown warns of a risk of flooding of the carriageway.

explain.short: There is no water in the picture: it is a soft verge.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'allagamento' (flooding) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous verge, not flooding

q19497.en: The sign shown warns that the road comes out onto a quay.

explain.short: A quay (road ending at water) has its own sign with a car falling into water.
explain.rule: 'Banchina pericolosa' (dangerous verge) is a danger sign: the verge beside the road is soft or unusable. Keep away from the right edge.
explain.trap: 'molo' (quay, pier) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Dangerous verge, not a quay

q19498.en: The sign shown warns of a traffic light installation with the lights arranged horizontally.

explain.short: Here the three discs are side by side: the lights ahead are horizontal.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'in orizzontale' (horizontal) matches the row of discs.

sceneParams.caption: Discs in a row: horizontal traffic lights

q19499.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: It is a red-edged triangle: the shape of danger signs.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'segnale di pericolo' (danger sign) = red-edged triangle.

sceneParams.caption: Red-edged triangle = danger sign

q19500.en: In the sign shown, the yellow disc can be replaced by a flashing yellow light.

explain.short: To be more visible, the yellow disc can be a real flashing yellow light.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: Only the YELLOW disc, and only 'lampeggiante' (flashing).

sceneParams.caption: Yellow disc can be a flashing light

q19501.en: The sign shown indicates that you must moderate your speed so you can stop if necessary.

explain.short: The light ahead may be red: slow down so you can stop in time.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'all'occorrenza' means 'if needed'.

sceneParams.caption: Slow down: be ready to stop

q19502.en: As a rule, the sign shown is placed 150 metres before a traffic light.

explain.short: Danger signs outside towns stand about 150 m before the danger, this one too.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'di norma' means 'as a rule': usually, not always exactly.

sceneParams.caption: As a rule 150 m before the lights

q19503.en: The sign shown indicates the obligation to stop at a police roadblock.

explain.short: A police checkpoint has its own 'Alt' sign; this triangle warns of traffic lights.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'posto di blocco' (roadblock) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not a police roadblock

q19504.en: The sign shown warns of a moving (lifting) bridge.

explain.short: A moving bridge has its own sign; the discs show traffic lights.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'ponte mobile' (moving bridge) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not a moving bridge

q19505.en: The sign shown warns of access to a ferry boarding pier.

explain.short: Ferries have their own information sign; this triangle warns of traffic lights.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'pontile d'imbarco' (boarding pier) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not a ferry pier

q19506.en: The sign shown can have the red disc replaced by a flashing red light.

explain.short: Only the yellow disc can become a flashing light, not the red.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'disco rosso' (red disc) is the trap: the rule is about the YELLOW disc.

sceneParams.caption: Only the YELLOW disc can flash

q19507.en: The sign shown warns of a railway crossing without barriers.

explain.short: The discs show traffic lights; an unbarriered crossing has a locomotive sign.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'attraversamento ferroviario' (railway crossing) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not a railway crossing

q19508.en: The sign shown warns of a level crossing with half barriers.

explain.short: A level crossing with barriers has a gate sign; this one shows traffic lights.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'passaggio a livello' (level crossing) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not a level crossing

q19509.en: The sign shown warns of reversible lanes.

explain.short: Reversible lanes are shown by lane lights and signs above the lanes, not by this triangle.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'corsie reversibili' (reversible lanes) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not reversible lanes

q19510.en: The sign shown warns of snowploughs at work.

explain.short: Snowploughs are shown with a '!' sign and a snowplough panel; this one shows traffic lights.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'sgombraneve' (snowploughs) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not snowploughs

q19511.en: The sign shown warns of a cycle crossing.

explain.short: A cycle crossing has its own sign with a bicycle; this one shows traffic lights.
explain.rule: 'Semaforo orizzontale' is a danger sign: traffic lights ahead with the lights side by side, as a rule 150 m before them.
explain.trap: 'attraversamento ciclabile' (cycle crossing) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic lights, not a cycle crossing
